source_name: Commercial job aggregators carrying regulator and public-finance postings (Optius, Careerjet SI, Borza dela, ESS)
why_relevant: Aggregators mirror regulator and ministry vacancies (an Optius employer page exists specifically for 'Ministrstvo za finance, Uprava RS za javna plačila (UJP)'; Borza dela and Careerjet carry 'banka slovenije' listings). Useful as a redundancy/latency check against the primary pages and as an archive when a primary posting is removed after its deadline. Lower authority: titles are sometimes rewritten and duplicates are common.

source_name: Glassdoor — Mercury Processing Services International employer profile
why_relevant: Employee-review surface for a processor with SI headcount; reorganizations, layoffs and management churn frequently show up in reviews before any public announcement.

Highest-reach commercial news portal; covers only the most prominent financial appointments (e.g. Primož Dolenc becoming Bank of Slovenia governor). Useful as a confirmation/salience signal rather than a primary break source.

source_name: Startup Slovenija / DIH Slovenia — FinTech Day and fintech events
why_relevant: FinTech Day and related events organised through the Slovenian startup ecosystem and the Digital Innovation Hub bring together fintech founders, bank innovation leads and investors. Attendee/speaker listings surface new Slovenian payments ventures and the bank staff seconded into innovation units.

source_name: ACI Slovenia (financial markets association, national member of ACI FMA)
why_relevant: National association of treasury/FX and money-market dealers; national-association pages carry the elected president/committee and contact person, all of whom are serving bank treasury staff — a narrow but high-signal index of treasury leadership in SI banks.

source_name: BorzaDela.si / mjob.si - student and temporary work marketplace
why_relevant: Large temporary/student work marketplace (10,000+ listings observed) with an IT category. Direct fetch of a hypothesised banking category returned only warehouse/hospitality student work and no banking employers, so its value for this cell is marginal - but it remains the right surface for back-office/contact-centre surges at banks, which often staff through student work.

Recurring Slovenian tax-and-finance conference; programme features finance-function leadership including bank tax/treasury/compliance specialists. A narrow but stable secondary roster for tracking mid-senior finance titles.

source_name: Delavska hranilnica – Vizitka in vodstvo (leadership roster)
why_relevant: Authoritative current-state roster of management board; diffing it detects departures that are never announced in a press release.

Described as the largest SI student-work intermediary (30+ years, 18 locations). Banks staff branch support, contact centres and back office through student work, so surges here are an early, cheap indicator of retail-network workload changes; it also has a commercial relationship with NLB, useful context on bank-side channel partnerships.

source_name: Eurofound — Collective bargaining in Slovenia country profile
why_relevant: Structural reference on how Slovenian bargaining works (industry and company level in the private sector; national private-sector bargaining ceased end-2005). Provides the institutional frame needed to interpret whether a banking-sector dispute is sectoral or firm-level, and identifies the tripartite bodies involved.

source_name: Joberty — Slovenian tech employer profiles and job ads
why_relevant: Adriatic-region developer platform carrying job ads plus employee reviews and salary signals for fintech employers such as Bitstamp; useful for role-level detail bank-only sources miss.

source_name: KiTalent — FinTech executive search (Slovenian-language practice page)
why_relevant: Executive-search firm marketing to Slovenian fintech; search-firm content and mandates reveal which leadership seats are being filled before any appointment is announced. Classic 'who sells into the change' source.

source_name: Knowledge Matters / Znanje šteje — international conference speakers
why_relevant: Slovenian-hosted international conference with a dedicated /govorci speakers page. Cross-sector, but historically features finance and management leadership; a secondary roster to diff for Slovenian financial-sector titles.
Push channel for STA English headlines; a cheap low-latency pointer that surfaces appointment items minutes after publication and links back to english.sta.si permalinks.

English-language Slovenian news aggregator historically republishing STA business items, including corporate leadership changes, for an expat/foreign-investor audience; distinct keyword surface from local media.

The submission side of the statutory vacancy flow; confirms how and where banking/payments employers file vacancy notices, and is the counterpart whose publication rules determine what appears in the public register.
